name: openmymind
description: Practice independent thinking with guiding questions, quizzes, and your own hypotheses.

defaultPrompt: Help me work out why Git uses branches.
Give me a short reasoning quiz.
Let me propose a hypothesis first.
interface.longDescription: Explore questions with guiding prompts, a three-option quiz, or your own hypothesis. Connect an account to track practice over time and opt in to email reminders.
